reason: The cargo mesh may support the growing potato stems, directly addressing the current goal.
expectation: I expect to add a support for the potato plants, though I’m unsure exactly how it will be fitted.

alternatives.reason: The lettuce is ready to harvest, but the stated goal concerns the potato stems.

effect: The mesh supports the spreading potato stems, and the next goal is to taste the first harvest.
reaction: It is satisfying to see the mesh fitted around the bed while the tubers continue growing.
reason: The lettuce is ready, and cutting it is the only offered combination that can advance the harvest goal.
expectation: I expect to harvest lettuce from the trough, though preparing it for a taste may take another step.

effect: The scissors produced fresh lettuce leaves, ready for the next stage of the harvest goal.
reaction: The result was straightforward, with nothing notable beyond getting the leaves.
reason: The galley is the natural place to prepare or taste the lettuce, and this is the only offered combination.
expectation: I expect to prepare or taste the fresh lettuce at the galley, though the exact result is uncertain.

effect: The lettuce became a fresh meal, completing the harvest goal and the chapter.
reaction: The green smell against the barren view is a memorable payoff for the growing process.

mostWorthwhile.text: The first fresh meal was the most worthwhile moment: its sensory detail made the harvest feel tangible.

leastWorthwhile.text: Cutting the lettuce was straightforward and its result added little detail on its own.

surprise.text: The mesh secured to the trough's metal shell gave the spreading stems support while leaving the root cover in place.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary; each had a clear purpose, though the harvest and galley steps were the only combinations offered at those points.

continue.text: I would choose to continue, partly to see how the still-developing potatoes turn out and what comes next for the expedition.
